name: reel-studio
description: Create, review and manage videos with editable motion templates in Codex and BB.

interface.longDescription: Plan short videos, reuse editable motion templates, review immutable versions and keep approval and publication records. Includes a theme-aware MCP App for Codex and a shared-workspace adapter for BB. Host-specific production integrations require separate configuration.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a new video template in Reel Studio.
